subject: [PATCH 1/6] mm/compaction: wait for pfn walkers before poisoning offlined memmap

reviews.author: David (Arm)
reviews.summary: Reviewer David (Arm) expressed strong disagreement with the patch order, stating that more important fixes are hidden in the series and that this change would not be a priority for backporting to stable kernels.
reviews.raw_body:
BTW, the order of these patches is all wrong.

There are much more important fixes hiding in this series. And this change here
would certainly not be the first thing we'd backport.

Please create a proper series that only addresses the pfn_to_online_page()
situation, without different, more urgent fixes.

Because there is no way we will fast track anything like this here into stable
kernels.

-- 
Cheers,

David

2026-10-27.patch_summary: This patch addresses a bug in the Linux kernel's compaction module where it fails to wait for pfn walkers before poisoning offlined memory maps, leading to DEBUG_VM faults. The fix involves holding an SRCU-fast read section from block check to last use of pages and making remove_pfn_range_from_zone() clear zone->contiguous and wait before poisoning. This patch also takes into account the contiguous zone skipping online checks and ensures scanner positions outlive the section.
